name: Vedant Rathi
player_statement:
A complete player, Vedant Rathi has made a big mark in cricket. With 45 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 44*, with an average of 8.84 and a quick strike rate of 94.33. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 28 sixes and 6 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 39.1 overs, taking 12 wickets at an economy rate of 9.04. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
